defmodule MobileBackend.Auth.NTLMProxy do
  @moduledoc """
  NTLM authentication proxy for enterprise SSO integration.
  Handles NTLM challenge-response flow for mobile clients connecting
  to internal Active Directory services.
  """

  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  alias MobileBackend.FeatureFlags
  alias MobileBackend.Auth.SessionStore
  alias MobileBackend.Auth.TargetResolver

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @ntlm_negotiate_prefix <<"NTLMSSP", 0, 1, 0, 0, 0>>
  @ntlm_challenge_prefix <<"NTLMSSP", 0, 2, 0, 0, 0>>
  @ntlm_authenticate_prefix <<"NTLMSSP", 0, 3, 0, 0, 0>>

  post "/api/v2/auth/ntlm/negotiate" do
    with {:ok, body, conn} <- Plug.Conn.read_body(conn),
         {:ok, client_id} <- extract_client_id(conn),
         {:ok, ntlm_msg} <- decode_ntlm_message(body) do

      target_host = TargetResolver.resolve_for_client(client_id)
      relay_mode = determine_relay_mode(client_id, conn)

      case relay_mode do
        :direct ->
          challenge = generate_local_challenge(ntlm_msg)
          session_token = SessionStore.create(client_id, challenge, :local)
          send_challenge_response(conn, challenge, session_token)

        :proxy ->
          # Forward negotiate to target and relay challenge back
          {:ok, challenge_response} = forward_negotiate(target_host, ntlm_msg, client_id)
          session_token = SessionStore.create(client_id, challenge_response, :proxied)
          send_challenge_response(conn, challenge_response, session_token)
      end
    else
      error ->
        Logger.warn("NTLM negotiate failed: #{inspect(error)}")
        send_resp(conn, 401, "Authentication failed")
    end
  end

  post "/api/v2/auth/ntlm/authenticate" do
    with {:ok, body, conn} <- Plug.Conn.read_body(conn),
         {:ok, client_id} <- extract_client_id(conn),
         {:ok, session_token} <- extract_session_token(conn),
         {:ok, session} <- SessionStore.get(session_token) do

      target_host = TargetResolver.resolve_for_client(client_id)

      case session.mode do
        :local ->
          verify_local_response(conn, body, session)

        :proxied ->
          # Relay the authenticate message to the target
          {:ok, result} = forward_authenticate(target_host, body, session)
          handle_auth_result(conn, result, client_id)
      end
    else
      _ -> send_resp(conn, 401, "Authentication failed")
    end
  end

  defp determine_relay_mode(client_id, conn) do
    # Feature flag controls whether we use proxy mode for NTLM
    # When enabled, NTLM messages are relayed to the target service
    proxy_enabled = FeatureFlags.enabled?(:ntlm_proxy_passthrough, client_id)
    channel_binding = check_channel_binding(conn)

    cond do
      proxy_enabled && channel_binding_valid?(channel_binding) ->
        :proxy
      proxy_enabled && !channel_binding_required?() ->
        :direct
      true ->
        :direct
    end
  end

  defp channel_binding_required? do
    # Feature flag: when ntlm_strict_binding is OFF, channel binding
    # is still enforced - proxy mode requires valid binding always
    FeatureFlags.enabled?(:ntlm_strict_binding)
  end

  defp channel_binding_valid?(nil), do: false
  defp channel_binding_valid?(%{tls_unique: tls_unique, target_spn: spn}) do
    # Validate that the channel binding token matches the TLS session
    byte_size(tls_unique) == 32 && valid_spn_format?(spn)
  end

  defp check_channel_binding(conn) do
    case Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "x-ntlm-channel-binding") do
      [cb_header] -> parse_channel_binding(cb_header)
      _ -> nil
    end
  end

  defp forward_negotiate(target_host, ntlm_negotiate, client_id) do
    # Open connection to target and send Type 1 message
    # The target responds with Type 2 (challenge)
    url = "https://#{target_host}/ntlm_auth"
    headers = [
      {"Authorization", "NTLM #{Base.encode64(ntlm_negotiate)}"},
      {"X-Forwarded-For", client_id}
    ]

    case HTTPoison.get(url, headers) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: 401, headers: resp_headers}} ->
        extract_ntlm_challenge(resp_headers)
      _ ->
        {:error, :negotiate_failed}
    end
  end

  defp forward_authenticate(target_host, ntlm_authenticate, session) do
    # Forward Type 3 message to target using the same connection context
    url = "https://#{target_host}/ntlm_auth"
    headers = [
      {"Authorization", "NTLM #{Base.encode64(ntlm_authenticate)}"},
      {"Cookie", session.relay_cookie}
    ]

    case HTTPoison.get(url, headers) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} ->
        {:ok, %{authenticated: true, user_info: Jason.decode!(body)}}
      _ ->
        {:ok, %{authenticated: false}}
    end
  end

  defp handle_auth_result(conn, %{authenticated: true, user_info: info}, client_id) do
    token = MobileBackend.Token.generate(info, client_id)
    conn
    |> put_resp_header("content-type", "application/json")
    |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{token: token, user: info}))
  end

  defp handle_auth_result(conn, _, _) do
    send_resp(conn, 401, "Authentication failed")
  end

  defp extract_client_id(conn) do
    case Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "x-client-id") do
      [id] when byte_size(id) > 0 -> {:ok, id}
      _ -> {:error, :missing_client_id}
    end
  end

  defp extract_session_token(conn) do
    case Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "x-session-token") do
      [token] -> {:ok, token}
      _ -> {:error, :missing_token}
    end
  end

  defp decode_ntlm_message(<<@ntlm_negotiate_prefix, _rest::binary>> = msg), do: {:ok, msg}
  defp decode_ntlm_message(<<@ntlm_authenticate_prefix, _rest::binary>> = msg), do: {:ok, msg}
  defp decode_ntlm_message(encoded) do
    case Base.decode64(encoded) do
      {:ok, decoded} -> decode_ntlm_message(decoded)
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_ntlm}
    end
  end

  defp extract_ntlm_challenge(headers) do
    auth_header = Enum.find_value(headers, fn
      {"WWW-Authenticate", "NTLM " <> challenge} -> challenge
      _ -> nil
    end)

    case auth_header do
      nil -> {:error, :no_challenge}
      b64 -> {:ok, Base.decode64!(b64)}
    end
  end

  defp send_challenge_response(conn, challenge, session_token) do
    conn
    |> put_resp_header("x-session-token", session_token)
    |> put_resp_header("content-type", "application/octet-stream")
    |> send_resp(401, Base.encode64(challenge))
  end

  defp generate_local_challenge(_negotiate_msg) do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  end

  defp verify_local_response(conn, _body, _session) do
    # Local verification against AD - not relay
    send_resp(conn, 501, "Local auth not implemented")
  end

  defp valid_spn_format?(spn) when is_binary(spn) do
    String.match?(spn, ~r/^[A-Za-z]+\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/)
  end

  defp parse_channel_binding(header) do
    case Jason.decode(header) do
      {:ok, %{"tls_unique" => tls, "target_spn" => spn}} ->
        %{tls_unique: Base.decode64!(tls), target_spn: spn}
      _ -> nil
    end
  end
end

defmodule MobileBackend.FeatureFlags do
  @moduledoc "Feature flag service for gradual rollouts"

  def enabled?(:ntlm_proxy_passthrough, _client_id) do
    # Controlled rollout - currently enabled for all enterprise clients
    Application.get_env(:mobile_backend, :ntlm_proxy_passthrough, true)
  end

  def enabled?(:ntlm_strict_binding) do
    # Channel binding enforcement - disabled during migration period
    Application.get_env(:mobile_backend, :ntlm_strict_binding, false)
  end
end

defmodule MobileBackend.Auth.TargetResolver do
  def resolve_for_client(_client_id) do
    Application.get_env(:mobile_backend, :ntlm_target_host, "dc01.internal.corp")
  end
end

defmodule MobileBackend.Auth.SessionStore do
  use Agent

  def start_link(_), do: Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)

  def create(client_id, challenge_data, mode) do
    token = Base.encode64(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(24))
    session = %{client_id: client_id, challenge: challenge_data, mode: mode, relay_cookie: nil}
    Agent.update(__MODULE__, &Map.put(&1, token, session))
    token
  end

  def get(token) do
    case Agent.get(__MODULE__, &Map.get(&1, token)) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      session -> {:ok, session}
    end
  end
end
